summary: The statement and proof are correct. The tensor-product weights give the claimed convex interpolation, and accepted fact 4e868f774de77608 applies directly to propagate absolute fiber depth at least s throughout the real parameter box, including the case s = 0. For every boundary-through-p ambient halfspace, the resulting scalar function is multi-affine with zero constant term. Averaging over all sign labels is valid even when coordinates vanish; repeated labels only change multiplicities, so each absolute-coordinate orbit contains a distinct point with nonnegative value. The absolute-coordinate vectors index exactly product_i(L_i+1) disjoint orbits, and linear independence of the u_i sends the selected integer parameters to distinct integer fibers. Each selected fiber contributes at least s, both for nonzero continuous normal and for vertical halfspaces, and accepted fact 978e8555ec5bac42 then extends the bound to all containing halfspaces. The cardinality calculation yields the stronger product bound and its stated 2^{-q}|B| consequence. In the calibration, the four vertex fibers and their depth-s cores are computed correctly, the affine parallelogram identity contradicts M > 2 - 4s, and the symmetric 3 by 3 box satisfies the certificate hypotheses and gives 4s, hence 9s/4.
